                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Border x:Name="border" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" CornerRadius="12">
                            <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        </Border>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="KnobButtonStyle" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#15FFFFFF"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="White"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#30FFFFFF"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="2"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Grid>
                            <Ellipse x:Name="el" Fill="{TemplateBinding Background}" Stroke="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" StrokeThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}"/>

                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0"/>

                <Setter.Value>
                    <Style TargetType="ListBoxItem">
                        <Setter Property="Template">
                            <Setter.Value>
                                <ControlTemplate TargetType="ListBoxItem">
                                    <Border x:Name="itemBorder" Background="#0AFFFFFF" CornerRadius="10" Padding="12" Margin="3" BorderBrush="Transparent" BorderThickness="1">
                                        <ContentPresenter />
                                    </Border>
                                    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                        <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                                            <Setter TargetName="itemBorder" Background="#30FFFFFF"/>
                                            <Setter TargetName="itemBorder" BorderBrush="White"/>
                                        </Trigger>
                                    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                </ControlTemplate>
                            </Setter.Value>
                        </Setter>
                    </Style>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
    </Application.Resources>
</Application>

<Window x:Class="KOYA_APP.ActionPicker"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        Title="Wybierz Akcje" Height="650" Width="450"
        Background="Transparent" WindowStyle="None" AllowsTransparency="True" 
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterOwner">

    <Border Background="White" BorderBrush="Black" BorderThickness="4" CornerRadius="0">
        <Grid Margin="30">
            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            </Grid.RowDefinitions>

            <!-- Header -->
            <StackPanel Grid.Row="0" Margin="0,0,0,30">
                <TextBlock Text="KOYA" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" Foreground="Black" 
                           FontSize="24" FontWeight="Black" HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                <TextBlock Text="ACTION SELECTOR" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" Foreground="Gray" 
                           FontSize="10" HorizontalAlignment="Center" LetterSpacing="3"/>
                <Separator Background="Black" Margin="0,15,0,0" Height="2"/>
            </StackPanel>

            <!-- Action List -->
            <ListBox x:Name="ActionsListBox" Grid.Row="1" Style="{StaticResource ActionListBoxStyle}" SelectionChanged="ActionsListBox_SelectionChanged">
                <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                    <DataTemplate>
                        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Icon}" FontFamily="{StaticResource IconFont}" Foreground="Black" 
                                       FontSize="22" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,20,0"/>
                            <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" Foreground="Black" FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold"/>
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Description}" Foreground="#666" FontSize="10" FontFamily="Segoe UI"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </DataTemplate>
                </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
            </ListBox>

            <!-- Settings Panel -->
            <StackPanel x:Name="ExtraSettingsPanel" Grid.Row="2" Visibility="Collapsed" Margin="0,20,0,0">
                <TextBlock x:Name="ExtraSettingsTitle" Text="CONFIGURATION" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" 
                           Foreground="Black" FontSize="10" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>
                <Border BorderBrush="Black" BorderThickness="1">
                    <Grid>
                        <ComboBox x:Name="DevicesComboBox" Visibility="Collapsed" Height="40" Background="White" Foreground="Black" BorderThickness="0"/>
                        <TextBox x:Name="ShortcutTextBox" Visibility="Collapsed" Height="40" Background="White" Foreground="Black" 
                                 TextAlignment="Center" VerticalContentAlignment="Center" IsReadOnly="True" BorderThickness="0"
                                 PreviewKeyDown="ShortcutTextBox_PreviewKeyDown" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" FontSize="12"/>
                    </Grid>
                </Border>
            </StackPanel>

            <!-- Buttons -->
            <UniformGrid Grid.Row="3" Columns="2" Margin="0,30,0,0">
                <Button Content="CANCEL" Click="Cancel_Click" Style="{StaticResource GlassButtonStyle}" 
                        Height="50" Margin="5" Background="White" Foreground="Black" BorderBrush="Black"/>
                <Button Content="SELECT" Click="Select_Click" Style="{StaticResource GlassButtonStyle}" 
                        Height="50" Margin="5" Background="Black" Foreground="White" BorderBrush="Black"/>
            </UniformGrid>
        </Grid>
    </Border>
</Window>

                <Button Content="OK" Click="Select_Click" Style="{StaticResource GlassButtonStyle}" Height="40" Margin="5" Background="#30FFFFFF"/>
            </UniformGrid>
        </Grid>
    </Border>
</Window>

<Application x:Class="KOYA_APP.App"
             xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             StartupUri="MainWindow.xaml">
    <Application.Resources>
        <FontFamily x:Key="MainFont">Audiowide, Segoe UI Semibold</FontFamily>
        <FontFamily x:Key="IconFont">Segoe MDL2 Assets</FontFamily>

        <Style x:Key="GlassButtonStyle" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#15FFFFFF"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="White"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#33FFFFFF"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="FontFamily" Value="{StaticResource MainFont}"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Border x:Name="border" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" CornerRadius="0">
                            <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="border" Property="Background" Value="White"/>
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="Black"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <Style x:Key="KnobButtonStyle" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="White"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="White"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="2"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Grid>
                            <Ellipse x:Name="el" Fill="{TemplateBinding Background}" Stroke="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" StrokeThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}"/>
                            <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="el" Property="Fill" Value="White"/>
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="Black"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>

<Application x:Class="KOYA_APP.App"
             xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
             xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
             StartupUri="MainWindow.xaml">
    <Application.Resources>
        <!-- Fonty -->
        <FontFamily x:Key="MainFont">Audiowide, Segoe UI Semibold</FontFamily>
        <FontFamily x:Key="IconFont">Segoe MDL2 Assets</FontFamily>

        <!-- Kolory KOYA -->
        <SolidColorBrush x:Key="KoyaBlack" Color="#000000"/>
        <SolidColorBrush x:Key="KoyaWhite" Color="#FFFFFF"/>
        <SolidColorBrush x:Key="KoyaGrey" Color="#1A1A1A"/>

        <!-- Styl przycisku kwadratowego (Siatka) -->
        <Style x:Key="GlassButtonStyle" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="#11FFFFFF"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="White"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#33FFFFFF"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1"/>
            <Setter Property="FontFamily" Value="{StaticResource MainFont}"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Border x:Name="border" Background="{TemplateBinding Background}" 
                                BorderBrush="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" 
                                BorderThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" 
                                CornerRadius="0"> <!-- Surowy styl, brak zaokraglen -->
                            <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        </Border>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="border" Property="Background" Value="White"/>
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="Black"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <!-- Styl Potencjometru (Knob) -->
        <Style x:Key="KnobButtonStyle" TargetType="Button">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="White"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="White"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="2"/>
            <Setter Property="Template">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <ControlTemplate TargetType="Button">
                        <Grid>
                            <Ellipse x:Name="el" Stroke="{TemplateBinding BorderBrush}" StrokeThickness="{TemplateBinding BorderThickness}" Fill="{TemplateBinding Background}"/>
                            <ContentPresenter HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                        </Grid>
                        <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                            <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                <Setter TargetName="el" Property="Fill" Value="White"/>
                                <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="Black"/>
                            </Trigger>
                        </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                    </ControlTemplate>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>

        <!-- Styl Listy w ActionPicker -->
        <Style x:Key="ActionListBoxStyle" TargetType="ListBox">
            <Setter Property="Background" Value="Transparent"/>
            <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="0"/>
            <Setter Property="ItemContainerStyle">
                <Setter.Value>
                    <Style TargetType="ListBoxItem">
                        <Setter Property="Template">
                            <Setter.Value>
                                <ControlTemplate TargetType="ListBoxItem">
                                    <Border x:Name="itemBorder" Background="Transparent" Padding="15" BorderThickness="0,0,0,1" BorderBrush="#22FFFFFF">
                                        <ContentPresenter />
                                    </Border>
                                    <ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                        <Trigger Property="IsSelected" Value="True">
                                            <Setter TargetName="itemBorder" Background="White"/>
                                            <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="Black"/>
                                        </Trigger>
                                        <Trigger Property="IsMouseOver" Value="True">
                                            <Setter TargetName="itemBorder" Background="#11FFFFFF"/>
                                        </Trigger>
                                    </ControlTemplate.Triggers>
                                </ControlTemplate>
                            </Setter.Value>
                        </Setter>
                    </Style>
                </Setter.Value>
            </Setter>
        </Style>
    </Application.Resources>
</Application>

<Window x:Class="KOYA_APP.ActionPicker"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        Title="Wybierz Akcje" Height="650" Width="450"
        Background="Transparent" WindowStyle="None" AllowsTransparency="True" 
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterOwner">

    <Border Background="White" BorderBrush="Black" BorderThickness="4" CornerRadius="0">
        <Grid Margin="30">
            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            </Grid.RowDefinitions>

            <!-- Header -->
            <StackPanel Grid.Row="0" Margin="0,0,0,30">
                <TextBlock Text="KOYA" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" Foreground="Black" 
                           FontSize="24" FontWeight="Black" HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                <TextBlock Text="ACTION SELECTOR" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" Foreground="Gray" 
                           FontSize="10" HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                <Separator Background="Black" Margin="0,15,0,0" Height="2"/>
            </StackPanel>

            <!-- Action List -->
            <ListBox x:Name="ActionsListBox" Grid.Row="1" Style="{StaticResource ActionListBoxStyle}" SelectionChanged="ActionsListBox_SelectionChanged">
                <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                    <DataTemplate>
                        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Icon}" FontFamily="{StaticResource IconFont}" Foreground="Black" 
                                       FontSize="22" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,20,0"/>
                            <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" Foreground="Black" FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold"/>
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Description}" Foreground="#666" FontSize="10"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </DataTemplate>
                </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
            </ListBox>

            <!-- Settings Panel -->
            <StackPanel x:Name="ExtraSettingsPanel" Grid.Row="2" Visibility="Collapsed" Margin="0,20,0,0">
                <TextBlock x:Name="ExtraSettingsTitle" Text="CONFIGURATION" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" 
                           Foreground="Black" FontSize="10" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>
                <Border BorderBrush="Black" BorderThickness="1">
                    <Grid>
                        <ComboBox x:Name="DevicesComboBox" Visibility="Collapsed" Height="40" Background="White" Foreground="Black" BorderThickness="0"/>
                        <TextBox x:Name="ShortcutTextBox" Visibility="Collapsed" Height="40" Background="White" Foreground="Black" 
                                 TextAlignment="Center" VerticalContentAlignment="Center" IsReadOnly="True" BorderThickness="0"
                                 PreviewKeyDown="ShortcutTextBox_PreviewKeyDown" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" FontSize="12"/>
                    </Grid>
                </Border>
            </StackPanel>

            <!-- Buttons -->
            <UniformGrid Grid.Row="3" Columns="2" Margin="0,30,0,0">
                <Button Content="CANCEL" Click="Cancel_Click" Style="{StaticResource GlassButtonStyle}" 
                        Height="50" Margin="5" Background="White" Foreground="Black" BorderBrush="Black"/>
                <Button Content="SELECT" Click="Select_Click" Style="{StaticResource GlassButtonStyle}" 
                        Height="50" Margin="5" Background="Black" Foreground="White" BorderBrush="Black"/>
            </UniformGrid>
        </Grid>
    </Border>
</Window>

<Window x:Class="KOYA_APP.ActionPicker"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        Title="Wybierz Akcje" Height="650" Width="450"
        Background="Transparent" WindowStyle="None" AllowsTransparency="True" 
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterOwner">

    <Border Background="White" BorderBrush="Black" BorderThickness="4" CornerRadius="0">
        <Grid Margin="30">
            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            </Grid.RowDefinitions>

            <!-- Header -->
            <StackPanel Grid.Row="0" Margin="0,0,0,30">
                <TextBlock Text="KOYA" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" Foreground="Black" 
                           FontSize="24" FontWeight="Black" HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                <TextBlock Text="ACTION SELECTOR" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" Foreground="Gray" 
                           FontSize="10" HorizontalAlignment="Center" LetterSpacing="3"/>
                <Separator Background="Black" Margin="0,15,0,0" Height="2"/>
            </StackPanel>

            <!-- Action List -->
            <ListBox x:Name="ActionsListBox" Grid.Row="1" Style="{StaticResource ActionListBoxStyle}" SelectionChanged="ActionsListBox_SelectionChanged">
                <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                    <DataTemplate>
                        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Icon}" FontFamily="{StaticResource IconFont}" Foreground="Black" 
                                       FontSize="22" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,20,0"/>
                            <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" Foreground="Black" FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold"/>
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Description}" Foreground="#666" FontSize="10" FontFamily="Segoe UI"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </DataTemplate>
                </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
            </ListBox>

            <!-- Settings Panel -->
            <StackPanel x:Name="ExtraSettingsPanel" Grid.Row="2" Visibility="Collapsed" Margin="0,20,0,0">
                <TextBlock x:Name="ExtraSettingsTitle" Text="CONFIGURATION" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" 
                           Foreground="Black" FontSize="10" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>
                <Border BorderBrush="Black" BorderThickness="1">
                    <Grid>
                        <ComboBox x:Name="DevicesComboBox" Visibility="Collapsed" Height="40" Background="White" Foreground="Black" BorderThickness="0"/>
                        <TextBox x:Name="ShortcutTextBox" Visibility="Collapsed" Height="40" Background="White" Foreground="Black" 
                                 TextAlignment="Center" VerticalContentAlignment="Center" IsReadOnly="True" BorderThickness="0"
                                 PreviewKeyDown="ShortcutTextBox_PreviewKeyDown" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" FontSize="12"/>
                    </Grid>
                </Border>
            </StackPanel>

            <!-- Buttons -->
            <UniformGrid Grid.Row="3" Columns="2" Margin="0,30,0,0">
                <Button Content="CANCEL" Click="Cancel_Click" Style="{StaticResource GlassButtonStyle}" 
                        Height="50" Margin="5" Background="White" Foreground="Black" BorderBrush="Black"/>
                <Button Content="SELECT" Click="Select_Click" Style="{StaticResource GlassButtonStyle}" 
                        Height="50" Margin="5" Background="Black" Foreground="White" BorderBrush="Black"/>
            </UniformGrid>
        </Grid>
    </Border>
</Window>

<Window x:Class="KOYA_APP.ActionPicker"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        Title="Wybierz Akcje" Height="650" Width="450"
        Background="Transparent" WindowStyle="None" AllowsTransparency="True" 
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterOwner">

    <Border Background="White" BorderBrush="Black" BorderThickness="4" CornerRadius="0">
        <Grid Margin="30">
            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            </Grid.RowDefinitions>

            <!-- Header -->
            <StackPanel Grid.Row="0" Margin="0,0,0,30">
                <TextBlock Text="KOYA" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" Foreground="Black" 
                           FontSize="24" FontWeight="Black" HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                <TextBlock Text="ACTION SELECTOR" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" Foreground="Gray" 
                           FontSize="10" HorizontalAlignment="Center"/>
                <Separator Background="Black" Margin="0,15,0,0" Height="2"/>
            </StackPanel>

            <!-- Action List -->
            <ListBox x:Name="ActionsListBox" Grid.Row="1" Style="{StaticResource ActionListBoxStyle}" SelectionChanged="ActionsListBox_SelectionChanged">
                <ListBox.ItemTemplate>
                    <DataTemplate>
                        <StackPanel Orientation="Horizontal">
                            <TextBlock Text="{Binding Icon}" FontFamily="{StaticResource IconFont}" Foreground="Black" 
                                       FontSize="22" VerticalAlignment="Center" Margin="0,0,20,0"/>
                            <StackPanel VerticalAlignment="Center">
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Name}" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" Foreground="Black" FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold"/>
                                <TextBlock Text="{Binding Description}" Foreground="#666" FontSize="10"/>
                            </StackPanel>
                        </StackPanel>
                    </DataTemplate>
                </ListBox.ItemTemplate>
            </ListBox>

            <!-- Settings Panel -->
            <StackPanel x:Name="ExtraSettingsPanel" Grid.Row="2" Visibility="Collapsed" Margin="0,20,0,0">
                <TextBlock x:Name="ExtraSettingsTitle" Text="CONFIGURATION" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" 
                           Foreground="Black" FontSize="10" Margin="0,0,0,10"/>
                <Border BorderBrush="Black" BorderThickness="1">
                    <Grid>
                        <ComboBox x:Name="DevicesComboBox" Visibility="Collapsed" Height="40" Background="White" Foreground="Black" BorderThickness="0"/>
                        <TextBox x:Name="ShortcutTextBox" Visibility="Collapsed" Height="40" Background="White" Foreground="Black" 
                                 TextAlignment="Center" VerticalContentAlignment="Center" IsReadOnly="True" BorderThickness="0"
                                 PreviewKeyDown="ShortcutTextBox_PreviewKeyDown" FontFamily="{StaticResource MainFont}" FontSize="12"/>
                    </Grid>
                </Border>
            </StackPanel>

            <!-- Buttons -->
            <UniformGrid Grid.Row="3" Columns="2" Margin="0,30,0,0">
                <Button Content="CANCEL" Click="Cancel_Click" Style="{StaticResource GlassButtonStyle}" 
                        Height="50" Margin="5" Background="White" Foreground="Black" BorderBrush="Black"/>
                <Button Content="SELECT" Click="Select_Click" Style="{StaticResource GlassButtonStyle}" 
                        Height="50" Margin="5" Background="Black" Foreground="White" BorderBrush="Black"/>
            </UniformGrid>
        </Grid>
    </Border>
</Window>
